# Personalize test fixtures: sources and licences

All files are written by `Source/Engine/Personalize/tools/make_fixtures.py` (run from the parent `AFM Input/`
workspace, see `docs/BUILDING.md`).

| Fixture | Content | Source / licence |
|---|---|---|
| `merge_fixture.json` | Random numbers (seeded NumPy) | Generated, no third-party content |
| `mcnemar_fixture.tsv` | p-values for fixed count tables | Generated, no third-party content |
| `calib_fit_fixture.jsonl` | Syllable counts, model scores and 0/1 labels (no text) | Generated from the project's own models |
| `nbest_fixture.jsonl`, rows `pool*` (10) | Simulated user sentences (medical style) | Generated locally with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (`mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-4bit`, Apache-2.0; the licence puts no restriction on outputs). Prompts used terms from 國家教育研究院樂詞網 (NAER open-data declaration) and 健保署 2023 中文版 ICD-10-CM (政府資料開放授權條款－第1版); see the attribution in `ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md` |
| `nbest_fixture.jsonl`, rows `repcv*` (10) | General-domain replay sentences | Mozilla Common Voice zh-TW sentence files, **CC0-1.0** |

N-best texts and scores in `nbest_fixture.jsonl` come from McBopomofo's language model (`Source/Data`, MIT).

Not contained (removed 2026-10-08 before publication): text generated by Apple Foundation Models and Tatoeba
sentences.
